annotations.text:
About page — minimalist.
Four things only: your photograph, a short introduction, the journey, press and awards. I left out the reference's stat band, skills chips, 'beyond work' illustration and selected-highlights row — say the word if you want any of them back.
Anything in [BRACKETS] is a fact I couldn't verify. Terracotta marks the ones inside body copy.
Your real headshot, re-graded so its seamless backdrop matches the page ground exactly. Three treatments — B (arch) is now on both breakpoints.
